meta.title: SCRIPE-Frontend Central Auth, HMAC Session Relay, Principal Isolation & Sudo MVVM

views.label: 1. Origin Routing & HMAC Relay
views.note: Custom domains detect isExternalCustomDomain() and proxy establish/refresh/logout through HMAC-signed Next.js BFF routes.

views.label: 2. Handoff Dispatch & Tab Isolation
views.note: ssoHandoffDispatch validates verified returnOrigin redirects while ActivePrincipal + BroadcastChannel isolate multi-tab principals.

views.label: 3. Sudo 403 Retry & Split Logout
views.note: api.service expands 403 Sudo retry across revocation/downgrade codes and useAuthLogout sends split logoutScope ('app' vs 'central').

boundaries.label: Client Core Origin, Principal & Sudo Security

components.label: Origin Routing Policy
components.explanation: Distinguishes auth.scripe.org, single-label workspace subdomains, and external custom domains while enforcing HTTPS on all non-localhost targets.

components.label: SSO Handoff Dispatcher
components.explanation: Redeems 120s ExternalAuthHandoffTicket and dispatches link completion, 2FA, workspace selection, or cross-origin /sso/callback redirects.

components.label: Active Principal Guard
components.explanation: Detects cross-tab tenant or principal divergence between per-tab sessionStorage and persisted Zustand state.

components.label: Auth Broadcast Sync
components.explanation: Filters LOGOUT, TOKEN_REFRESHED, and IMPERSONATION events strictly by matching origin, tenant, and principalId.

components.label: Relay HMAC Signer
components.explanation: Validates Sec-Fetch-Site/Origin same-origin invariant and signs canonical backend relay requests with timestamp and random nonce.

components.label: BFF Session Relay API
components.explanation: Reads/rotates/clears first-party __Host-scripe_refresh_token (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax) on verified custom tenant domains.

components.label: ApiService Sudo Gate
components.explanation: Intercepts 403 SudoRequired, SudoExpired, SudoSessionMismatch, SudoRevokedOrExpired, SudoPolicyDowngradeRefused, and SudoTokenInvalid to elevate and replay.

components.label: SudoVerificationModal
components.explanation: Renders global on-demand Sudo step-up UI driven by policy hierarchy and passkey/TOTP/password panels.

components.label: useAuthLogout ViewModel
components.explanation: Orchestrates app-scoped vs central SSO logout through custom-domain relay or direct API, clearing local store cleanly.

components.label: auth.scripe.org
components.explanation: Hosts /sso/continue for centralized workspace picker, MFA challenge, and verified cross-origin handoff redirect.

components.label: api.scripe.org
components.explanation: Redeems ExternalAuthHandoffTicket, verifies HMAC relay headers, enforces Sudo behavior, and splits scr.oidc.session.
